rollups.text: Photography development: By 2023-05-25, the user had been using a 50mm lens continuously and was pleased with portrait results; a new lens bought around 2023-05-04 was described as a game-changer. On 2023-05-25, the user sought portrait tutorials, camera servicing information for a Canon EOS 80D, and Lightroom advice for portraits from a shoot with Sarah. On 2023-05-30, the user discussed vintage cameras, including a 1930s Leica purchased for $150, and decided to try film photography, especially black-and-white city photographs. The user wanted a simple, minimal-equipment path for developing and scanning film at home after feeling overwhelmed by extensive recommendations. Latest state: excited to shoot the first roll; no development setup was confirmed.

Aquarium care and fish plans: On 2023-02-01, the user fed the fish frozen brine shrimp for the first time and cleaned gravel and decorations. By 2023-05-24, the user reported platies fin-nipping neon tetras despite rearranging decorations and adding hiding places and visual barriers. The user was monitoring water parameters, saw a slight nitrate increase, and said they would increase water changes; they reported changing about 25% of the water with dechlorinated water, with the meaning of “bi-weekly” unclear. The user had set up a separate breeding tank for platies and was considering harlequin rasboras, lemon tetras, or zebra danios; they planned to introduce harlequin rasboras, but no introduction was confirmed.

On 2023-05-30, the user said they had recently started attending classes three times a week, sought stress-relief routines, and was interested in Yin Yoga. They were considering daily home practice and a peaceful home yoga space with a sustainable mat and props. Separately, on 2023-05-27, the user was trying to wake 30 minutes earlier for a 15-minute routine including stretching and sun salutations and considered adding meditation through a familiar yoga app.

Because the group sometimes fell several versions behind, the user planned automatic updates and vendor email notifications, then said they would share the guidance with colleagues and ensure recommended practices were implemented. Latest state: implementation was planned, not confirmed.
